# The homotopy category of the pretriangulated envelope is the triangulated subcategory generated by the objects of `C`

the closure under isomorphisms of the one-sided twisted
complexes is the smallest triangulated subcategory of the homotopy category of twisted objects
which is closed under isomorphisms and contains the image `X[0]` of every object `X` of `C`.

```lean
TauCeti.DGTwistedObject.isLeast_isoClosure_oneSided.{v, u} (R : Type v) [CommRing R] (C : Type u)
  [TauCeti.DGCategory R C] :
  IsLeast
    {S |
      S.IsTriangulated ∧
        S.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms ∧
          ∀ (X : C),
            S
              (TauCeti.DGHomotopyCategory.of R
                ((TauCeti.DGTwistedObject.embedding R).obj
                  ((TauCeti.DGAdditiveClosure.embedding R).obj
                    ((TauCeti.DGShiftClosure.ι R).obj X))))}
    (TauCeti.DGTwistedObject.oneSided R C).isoClosure
```
